about_item: Max Strength Formula - effectively eliminates fleas and ticks on contact, including larvae and eggs, and fends off mosquitos for up to 2 weeks when used as directed.
Natural Ingredients - Skout's Honor Flea+Tick Shampoo is powered by essential oils like fresh peppermint and cedarwood, making it a safe and effective choice.
Smells Amazing - formulated with natural cedarwood and peppermint essential oils that you'll love.
Not recommended for topical use on cats - when applying throughout the home, remove all cats from the area until the product has dried completely.
Paw Pledge - Together with their customers, Skout's Honor provides a day's worth of food to an animal in need, with every product sold (Buy a Bottle, Feed an Animal).

authors_reviews.title: IT WORKS!
authors_reviews.text: This is the only product that works. We can't use collars or medication on our Standard Poodle because of seizures, so we've had to do a lot of trial and error until we found this. Just make sure you leave it on for at least 5 minutes to do it's job.
authors_reviews.author: paul w.

authors_reviews.title: Works Well and Smells Nice
authors_reviews.text: This works really well but does have to sit on their fur for 5-7 minutes to properly kill the fleas. I found it easiest to bathe my dog outside with the hose and let her run around for the 7 minutes... doing it in the bathtub is really hard because her legs would still be submerged in water. Overall would recommend.. nice peppermint scent as well.
authors_reviews.author: Kristen Pursel
